sentences.en: She put an ice pack on her forehead to relieve the pain.
sentences.zh: 她把冰袋敷在额头上以缓解疼痛。

sentences.en: Make sure the ice pack is wrapped in a cloth before using it.
sentences.zh: 使用前请确保把冰袋包裹在布里。

sentences.en: The doctors gave him an ice pack to help reduce swelling after surgery.
sentences.zh: 医生给他用了冰袋来帮助减少手术后的肿胀。

senses.zh: 冰袋（用于受伤等部位降温）
